questions.title: Contains Duplicate
questions.statementMd:
Given an integer array `nums`, return `true` if any value appears at least twice, and `false` if every element is distinct.

**Constraints**

- `1 <= nums.length <= 100000`
- `-1000000 <= nums[i] <= 1000000`

python.driver:
if __name__ == "__main__":
    import sys, json
    _args = [json.loads(_l) for _l in sys.stdin.read().split("\n") if _l.strip() != ""]
    _out = Solution().containsDuplicate(*_args)
    print(json.dumps(_out, separators=(",", ":")))

questions.title: Longest Consecutive Sequence
questions.statementMd:
Given an unsorted integer array `nums`, return the length of the longest sequence of consecutive integers that can be formed from its values.

The elements do not need to be adjacent in the array, and duplicates count once. Aim for an `O(n)` solution.

**Constraints**

- `0 <= nums.length <= 100000`
- `-1000000 <= nums[i] <= 1000000`

python.driver:
if __name__ == "__main__":
    import sys, json
    _args = [json.loads(_l) for _l in sys.stdin.read().split("\n") if _l.strip() != ""]
    _out = Solution().longestConsecutive(*_args)
    print(json.dumps(_out, separators=(",", ":")))
